name: uams-web/uamswp-gravityforms-notification
description: Development tooling for UAMSWP Gravity Forms Notification

scripts-descriptions.setup:integration: Install the Integration suite's own Composer setup (PHPUnit 9.6, wp-phpunit, the polyfills).
scripts-descriptions.test: Run both suites, each in its own process, so the Unit suite never sees WordPress.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the PHPUnit 9.6 suite that boots WordPress through wp-phpunit against the test database.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan (WordPress extension) at the configured level.
scripts-descriptions.refactor:sweep: Apply every Rector rule, including the sweep-only ones. Review the diff.
scripts-descriptions.test:refactor: Report what the gating Rector rules would change.
scripts-descriptions.test:refactor:sweep: Report what the sweep Rector profile would change.
scripts-descriptions.test:pint: Check formatting with Pint without changing files.
